Build your Outline 📝 — "Create an outline for a 10-12 page guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Give me a chapter-by-chapter structure with a one-sentence summary for each section." 2. Write it ✍️ — "Write a short, conversational section about [SUBTOPIC]. Keep it simple, include one real-world example, under 250 words." Add your own voice after. 3.
